summary: Completed testing of 2 new Akkord features: 1) Akkord toggle in Settings page enables/disables piece-rate payment per group, 2) Akkord payment sharing displays proportional worker payments based on hours worked. All 12 backend tests pass. Frontend UI correctly shows/hides Akkord option and displays individual worker payments.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - minor accessibility concern

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/settings/group returns akkord_enabled field (default True)
Backend: PUT /api/settings/group with akkord_enabled=false disables akkord
Backend: POST /api/work-logs with work_type=akkord returns 400 when akkord disabled
Backend: PUT /api/settings/group with akkord_enabled=true enables akkord
Backend: POST /api/work-logs with work_type=akkord succeeds when akkord enabled
Backend: Hourly work is always allowed regardless of akkord setting
Backend: Single worker gets 100% of total payment
Backend: Two workers with equal hours split payment 50/50
Backend: Two workers with unequal hours get proportional payment (80%/20%)
Backend: Worker payment fields (payment, share_percentage, hours, user_name) in response
Backend: Three workers different hours proportional (50%/30%/20%)
Backend: Hourly work type also supports proportional payment sharing
Frontend: Settings page shows Work Log Settings section with Akkord toggle
Frontend: Akkord toggle is a Switch component with data-testid='akkord-toggle'
Frontend: When Akkord disabled, only Hourly Work button visible in Add Work dialog
Frontend: When Akkord enabled, both Piece Rate (Akkord) and Hourly Work buttons visible
Frontend: Work Log table shows Workers column with individual payments (e.g., 'Test Admin: 10t - 1 125,00 kr')
Frontend: Calculated Payment preview shows rate calculation (e.g., '18 kr/m² × 100 m²')
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding aria-describedby to DialogContent for better accessibility (currently showing console warning)
seed_data_creation: Test work logs created during backend testing (deleted after each test). Frontend work log entry created showing proportional payment (Test Admin: 10t - 1125kr, Payroll Test Worker: 6t - 675kr, total: 1800kr)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Akkord features fully implemented and tested: 1) Akkord enable/disable toggle in Settings works - backend validates and frontend hides/shows Akkord option accordingly. 2) Proportional payment sharing works - each worker's payment calculated as (worker_hours / total_hours) * total_payment, displayed in Workers column of Work Log table. Base operations: avtrekk (18kr/m²), skuring (22kr/m²), glatting (26kr/m²). Default hourly rate: 300kr/time.

feature_1_akkord_toggle.backend: GET /api/settings/group returns akkord_enabled (default True). PUT accepts akkord_enabled field. POST /api/work-logs validates akkord_enabled before allowing akkord work type.
feature_1_akkord_toggle.frontend: Settings page shows Work Log Settings section with Switch toggle for Akkord. When disabled, Work Log Add dialog shows only Hourly Work button. When enabled, shows both Piece Rate (Akkord) and Hourly Work buttons.

feature_2_payment_sharing.backend: Worker payment calculated proportionally: (worker.hours / total_hours) * total_payment. Response includes workers array with user_id, user_name, hours, share_percentage, and payment fields.
feature_2_payment_sharing.frontend: Work Log table Workers column displays each worker's name, hours, and individual payment amount (e.g., 'Test Admin: 10t - 1 125,00 kr'). All Work tab shows share_percentage additionally.
